h1: Custom Two Tone Blankets for Your Brand
metaTitle: Custom Two Tone Blankets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom two tone blankets with your logo. Soft, reversible styles perfect for corporate gifts and events. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Two tone blankets offer a modern twist on classic promotional blankets, featuring contrasting colors that highlight your logo with style. Whether you choose a frosted sherpa finish or a reversible design, these blankets stand out in employee appreciation programs or client gifts. The dual-color construction adds depth and visual interest, making your brand message pop at trade shows or corporate events. Customize with screen printing or embroidery for a polished look that recipients will use for years.
heroAltText: Custom two tone blankets with embroidered logo, soft sherpa fabric in contrasting colors
